result.title: Align3D: Image-Structure Co-Aligned 3D Scene Generation with Observability-Aware Fidelity-Preserving Guidance
result.summary: We present Align3D, an image-conditioned diffusion model that generates 3D indoor layouts that are both faithful to a single input photograph and physically plausible beyond the observed view. From the photograph we infer a confidence-calibrated scene graph and train a set-diffusion layout denoiser with image-structure co-alignment where confidence-weighted modality fusion balances image and scene-graph alignment using predicted confidences, while observability-aware fidelity-preserving guidance projects conflicting scene-quality gradients and reweighs them with an object-level confidence mask so under-observed degrees of freedom absorb physical priors without undoing the image-graph match. On 3D-FRONT, Align3D improves image-alignment and scene-quality metrics over recent baselines; once trained, it maps previously unseen photographs to layouts in a single feed-forward pass.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Align3D，一个以单张照片为条件的扩散模型，生成既贴合图像又可外推到未观测视角的 3D 室内布局，依靠置信度校准的场景图、模态置信加权融合与可观测性感知的保真引导，在 3D-FRONT 上提升图像对齐与场景质量指标，推理为单次前馈。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用对象级置信度掩码区分已观测与欠观测自由度、并让先验只填补欠观测部分而不破坏图像-场景图匹配的做法，可能为 LVR 中「视觉证据不足时先验如何补位、又如何避免信息坍缩」提供线索，但该机制作用于布局输出空间而非 latent 推理状态，迁移可行性需核查。
